title: iOS 12's most fun feature is hiding in your iPhone keyboard - here's how to create your own 'Memoji' (AAPL)
text: iOS 12's most fun feature is hiding in your iPhone keyboard — here's how to create your own 'Memoji' (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Sep 19, 2018, 9:25 am 22 pts The most whimsical new feature in the new version of iOS is called "Memoji." Since last year, Apple's high-end phones have allowed you to transform your face into a cartoon character, and control it with your eyes and mouth. Now, in iOS 12, you can even customize a version for your own face, kind of…
